decks.notes: This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using efficient countermagic and removal spells, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It focuses on tempo plays to keep the opponent on the back foot, utilizing cards like Daze and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to keep up the pressure. The deck also features powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of disruptive lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers further solidifies the deck's strategy of disrupting the opponent while maintaining a strong offensive presence.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's plays while maintaining aggressive pressure with efficient creatures and spells. Utilize cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the board and protect your threats. Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide powerful win conditions, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps filter through your deck. The inclusion of disruptive lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers adds another layer of control to the deck, allowing you to keep your opponent on the back foot while you push for victory.

The deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent's game plan while using cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Sheltered by Ghosts to protect your own creatures. Chalice of the Void is used to further disrupt the opponent's strategy, while cards like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Witch Enchanter provide card advantage. The deck also utilizes fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox to quickly get ahead on board. With a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive elements, this deck aims to maintain control of the game and overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Doomsday to combo off and win the game, using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly. It includes protection cards like Force of Will and Daze to ensure the combo resolves successfully. The Fantasticar is a crucial piece of the combo, allowing for a quick and efficient win condition when paired with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help assemble the combo pieces efficiently.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Gaea's Cradle and mana dorks, and controlling the board with cards like Endurance and Collector Ouphe. It can quickly fetch powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth with Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order, overwhelming the opponent with large threats. The deck also utilizes cards like Misty Rainforest and Verdant Catacombs for consistent land drops, while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent through efficient creature plays and control elements.

The main idea of this Combo - Reanimator deck is to quickly discard powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into the graveyard using cards like Unmask and Faithless Looting, and then bring them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to control the opponent's hand, as well as mana acceleration cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to cast spells ahead of schedule. This allows the deck to create powerful board states and win the game quickly through a combination of graveyard recursion and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping mana with cards like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors, while using Show and Tell to cheat big threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield. Sneak Attack and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide additional ways to cheat out big creatures like Emrakul. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce for protection, as well as cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overpower the opponent with big threats.

The deck revolves around controlling the game by using powerful counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also utilizes card draw and manipulation effects to find key cards and maintain card advantage. The deck aims to outlast the opponent's threats while gradually gaining control of the game and winning through incremental advantage. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional utility and card advantage to further solidify the control strategy. Additionally, the deck has a flexible mana base to support its various spells and ensure consistency in casting its spells.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures, backed up by powerful support cards. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Static Prison. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional threats and synergy with the deck's creature base. The deck also includes a land destruction package with cards like Wasteland and Karakas to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the main focus is on early aggression and disruption to quickly close out games.

The deck focuses on utilizing combo pieces like Goblin Welder and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to manipulate artifacts in the graveyard and on the battlefield, creating powerful synergies. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Engineer and Pinnacle Emissary helps to search for key pieces and maintain card advantage. Giving access to various artifact-based win conditions like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Phyrexian Dragon Engine, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with a combination of powerful effects and resource management.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by ramping up mana with Cloudpost and Tron lands to cast powerful spells and finishers. It includes a mix of counterspells like Force of Negation and Force of Will to protect the mana ramp, along with versatile removal options like Dismember and Kozilek's Command. The key finishers are Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms, allowing for dominant board presence and access to game-winning artifacts like The One Ring. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace opponents through efficient resource management.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy revolves around using cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up a game-winning combo with creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes ways to dig through the deck for key pieces with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder, ensuring a smooth execution of the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and card advantage to assemble the combo pieces needed to power up The Fantasticar. Emry, Lurker of the Loch acts as a key piece to recur artifacts from the graveyard, while Chalice of the Void and Force of Will help control the board. Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble provide additional value and synergy with the artifact-heavy strategy. The goal is to quickly ramp into powerful artifacts and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage and powerful threats.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creature plays such as Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, backed up by powerful support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Hexing Squelcher to control the opponent's board. With a mix of efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and burn potential from cards like Goblin Bombardment, this deck aims to maintain pressure and control the pace of the game to secure a swift victory.

This combo deck revolves around using Doomsday to stack the top of your library with specific cards, enabling you to win the game in a single turn. The Fantasticar serves as a key piece in setting up your combo, while cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze help protect your strategy. With careful planning and sequencing, you can execute your game-winning sequence and secure victory before your opponent has a chance to respond. The deck is built around speed, efficiency, and precision in executing your combo.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to establish board presence quickly using cards like Reality Smasher and Eldrazi Obligator, while also utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Eldrazi Temple. The inclusion of cards like Wastescape Battlemage and Kozilek's Command also provide additional versatility and control options to deal with various threats or situations.
